checks: One global monotonic 480-second deadline is created before startup; readiness receives deadline minus 60 seconds.
The only controller cleanup path uses stop_owned_process(30,10) and at most a 20-second group/ports/GPU proof wait.
Popen occurs before readiness; owned_process is written immediately; post-ready birth requires PID=PGID=session.
Readiness requires both health status ok and maintenance serving. The new loading-then-serving test proves loading status ok does not admit measurement.
The measured endpoint is http://127.0.0.1:32103 (no /v1); allxy owns endpoint extension behavior.
Dynamic d0_actual_admission is derived only after actual PID/start_ticks, written newly, chmod 0444, and re-read through sealed().
The sealed admission verifies source pins, controller pin, allxy template pin, and template non-symlink/non-writable state.
Fresh service root, private ports, GPU-idle gate, owned group dead, port reuse, and GPU-idle cleanup proof are present.
launch_preconditions: Synchronize the reviewed controller and test source to /data2/FreeToken, then verify remote SHA-256 equals every local_source_pins entry applicable to remote.
Run the same remote controller test file and require the reviewed 7-pass result after source synchronization.
The final sealed admission must pin the final controller SHA, all source_pins, the readonly allxy admission/template, INPUT_FREEZE, D07/window/native inputs, and the approved private service budget.
non_claims: No GPU launch, model service, API request, benchmark, or production acceptance was performed.
This review does not approve a remote launch while its source pins differ.

remote_read_only_observation.finding: Remote controller and tests do not match the reviewed local final pins.

scope: Static and CPU-only review. No GPU, service, HTTP/API, simulation, lock, or production operation was performed.
